dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Thanks be to the God King. All goes as planned.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Hmm? An outlander? Here? Are you a pilgrim, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Still, no wonder. The great works of Remuria are worth the admiration of all peoples!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Also, since the God King has granted you leave to bask in his glory, I have no right to object.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the plan you speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Ah, that. I am presently working on the research plans for our institution. There is much to do, but thanks to the God King's radiant blessing, we have many clever minds and hands to take up the work.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: To be entrusted with such duties in his blessed name — ah, such happiness is mine that shall never be surpassed.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Believe me, this is undoubtedly a win-win collaboration.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still planning collabs, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: I... *sigh* I just want to invest in those gentlemen and their Daydream Club, but they keep refusing!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Garcia, especially. He refuses no matter what I say or what promises I make. If anything, he just wants me to leave!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: They misunderstand! I... I mean, I used to be that way, but I've changed! I've completely repented and started anew! I want to support their research careers!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I must admit that I'm doubtful myself...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: You... Alright, it is true. An evil-doer turning about suddenly and claiming to wish to do good? You'd sooner trust a venomous snake that greets a person warmly with fangs dripping...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Fortunately, Mécantre and Babisse have agreed to let me stay here for a time... I've also agreed to provide financial support to their mega cannon.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Perhaps I must do something tangible and visible to prove my intent...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Their giant cannon project really does have a lot of appeal, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Even if it can't be built, the project name itself will attract many investors.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: And then, we just need to work a little magic and...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ahem, ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Uh, I mean... work our magic to attract lots of investors and researchers with similar interests...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: M—Many hands make light work, after all! With this many supporters, we shall have no fear of failure, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: *sigh* Take care...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Indeed. Take care!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Ah, there is truly no hope for me... Why did I... Oh, Archons, why did I do those things...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: I'm just like that person. I wanted to pull the strings. Let others do my bidding. No... No, no, no...
